behaviors.name: TireEffects
behaviors.source:
behavior TireEffects
  intent "Tire smoke and rubber marks wherever a rear tire slides"
  var marks = 0
  on tick
    let s = vehicle_state(self)
    if s.skid < 0.3 then
      stop
    end
    let v = velocity(self)
    let heading = deg(atan2(-v.x, -v.z))
    for name in ["rear_left", "rear_right"]
      let w = vehicle_wheel(self, name)
      if w and w.skid > 0.3 then
        if name == "rear_left" then
          burst(find("Smoke RL"), 1 + w.skid * 3)
        else
          burst(find("Smoke RR"), 1 + w.skid * 3)
        end
        if marks < 600 and frame % 2 == 0 then
          let m = spawn("plane", w.point + (0, 0.012, 0), "Skid Mark")
          m.scale = (0.22, 1, 0.42)
          m.rotation = (0, heading, 0)
          m.mesh.color = #121214
          m.mesh.roughness = 0.97
          marks += 1
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

behaviors.name: ShowcaseDrift
behaviors.source:
behavior ShowcaseDrift
  intent "With demo = true the car drives itself: a run-up, a handbrake flick and a long power slide (trailers, renders, tests)"
  var demo = false
  var t = 0
  on tick
    if not demo then
      stop
    end
    t += dt
    if t < 3.4 then
      vehicle_drive(self, 1, 0)
    elif t < 3.9 then
      vehicle_drive(self, 0.3, -1, 0, 1)
    elif t < 4.3 then
      vehicle_drive(self, 1, -0.3)
    else
      vehicle_drive(self, 1, 0.3)
    end
  end
end

behaviors.name: PhotoRig
behaviors.source:
behavior PhotoRig
  intent "A low three-quarter view that follows the coupe (renders; not the player's camera)"
  param side = 1 in -1..1 "which side of the car"
  on tick
    let car = find("Coupe")
    let v = velocity(car)
    let f = forward(car)
    if v.length > 3 then
      f = (v.x, 0, v.z) / (v.x, 0, v.z).length
    end
    let r = (-f.z, 0, f.x)
    self.position = car.position + f * 9 + r * (3 * side) + (0, 1.1, 0)
    look self at car.position + (0, 0.5, 0)
  end
end
